manuscript_title: Beam Deflection at the support span

evidence.quote: The earlier protocol recorded beam deflection at the support span only under dry conditions.
Under dry conditions, the probe measured 13 mm at the support span.

rows.text: Earlier work covered the dry condition. Our record adds the observed 13 mm at the support span; other conditions remain open.
rows.difference: The field observation and the separate reference use distinct instruments.
rows.gap: The earlier protocol recorded beam deflection at the support span only under dry conditions.
rows.response: We report a bounded measurement of 13 mm.
rows.boundary: Only the dry condition was observed; the beam deflection outside that condition was not measured.
